title: HYDROXYLATION OF BENZENES INVOLVING THE NIH SHIFT UTILIZING ELECTRONIC MODEL COMPOUND FOR MONOOXYGENASES
abstract: Abstract                The reaction of anisole-4-2H or toluene-4-2H with 2-hydroperoxyhexafluoro-2-propanol gave corresponding phenols involving the NIH shift, the extent of which was 57% and 51% respectively. These values were very close to those of cytochrome P450.
